title: Gluing affine smooth models at a common stage
statement: Given the affine smooth model and comparison data for a finitely presented pullback over a noetherian approximation, there is a later stage j such that the original pullback projection is smooth.

source.place: Tag 0C0C, limits.tex, lemma-descend-smooth, with Situation 081D; affine descent via Tag 0CAQ and comparison via Tag 01ZM(2)-(3)

proof.text: Unpack the later stage j, the smooth model q, and the comparison isomorphism e over the stage base. Its compatibility equation is e.hom ≫ pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom) = q. Composing with e.inv gives pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom) = e.inv ≫ q. Smoothness of an isomorphism and closure of smooth morphisms under composition prove smoothness of this projection. Return j. This is exactly the complete proof of the existing upstream theorem; the active parent supplies e = Iso.refl and the compatibility by Category.id_comp.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.smooth_stage_of_affine_models
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) {i : N.I}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ N.D.obj i)
    (hmodel : ∃ (j : Over i) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ N.D.obj j.left)
      (e : Z ≅ pullback p (N.D.map j.hom)),
        e.hom ≫ pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom) = q ∧ Smooth q) :
    ∃ j : Over i, Smooth (pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom))
